H1_skill.claim: frozen calendar V+F (20/month, 240/yr) catches more pre-onset events than its own alerts shifted in time
H1_skill.test: one-sided circular-shift permutation, 10000 shifts of 7 days to (period - 7 days), seed 20261029

H2_scheduler.claim: calendar cap beats rolling30, paced and token_bucket (notebook-4 designs, B=240, 2022 thresholds, warm-up from 2017-12-01)
H2_scheduler.test: one-sided exact McNemar on pre-onset hits, Holm over 3 comparisons

H3_capacity: descriptive: share of calendar-missed events with no monthly room left during their whole warning window; signal-reachable events

capacity_candidate.rule: among P2 and P3: most pre-onset hits; passed to notebook 11 only if strictly more pre-onset hits than P0 AND realized alerts <= 1.02 x P0 alerts; ties -> P3 (no recalibration needed)

crossvenue_candidate.rule: challenger (M1-M4) with the most pre-onset hits; ties -> fewer features; passed to notebook 11 only if strictly more pre-onset hits than M0_VF on the same comparison mask, otherwise no candidate

H4_candidates.crossvenue_not_evaluable_if: downloaded futures 2020 do not match the futures cache exactly, or cross-venue features do not match
H4_candidates.test: one-sided exact McNemar (candidate better) on pre-onset hits vs the matching calendar baseline, Holm over candidates

data.futures: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT monthly 1m 2019-09..2020-12 (only if a cross-venue candidate exists)
data.spot: Binance spot BTCUSDT monthly 1m archives 2017-08..2020-12, SHA-256 verified

events: notebook-2 price-only rule (4% below prior 240-min peak, 5 closes, 24h refractory) on the downloaded series; evaluation events: breach in [2018-01-01 04:00, 2021-01-01)
guards: downloaded 2020 spot prices equal the spot cache
recomputed 2020-03..12 events equal the spot catalog
model: V+F logistic, 2021 spot cache (identical to notebook 5), applied backwards (backcast)
primary_endpoint: alert 30-240 min before the 4% breach AND before the 1% onset (pre-onset hit), one alert per event
prior_use: not evaluated by this pipeline; GitHub hS-vs-volatility study used 2018-01..2020-09 once with a different event definition
rules: all outcomes reported as observed; no rule changes after reading outcomes; second evaluation refused (lock file)
secondary: high-score calendar and constant bucket (notebooks 5-6 frozen thresholds); any-hit endpoint; year-by-year
